publicMetrics.scope: full 3D mass-weighted fields and fixed initial denominators; modal projection alone cannot hide rigid/out-of-plane/other-mode drift; no convergence assertion from matching a trajectory
publicMetrics.referenceMeaning: unchanged independent exact-UV physical CST comparator; public projection is not authoritative q
